email.subject: P1 — payments 5xx spike — status update please
email.body:
P1. Customers see errors. I need a status update, not a code fix.

WHAT HAPPENED
Payments is throwing errors. Leadership wants four facts.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. CloudWatch, Dashboards, payments-api: read the CPU.
2. CloudWatch, Alarms: read HighCPU-payments state.
3. Logs Insights on /finova/payments: note timeout and 5xx lines.
4. Decide the escalation.

DO NOT
Do not deploy code. Do not stop production.

REPLY WITH
A short status: metric, alarm state, what the logs show, and that you are escalating to L2 on-call.

— Meera

steps.instruction: Pull metric + alarm + log signals into one timeline.
Escalate to L2/on-call; L1 sends status not a silent fix.

reply.model_reply: Status: payments 5xx spike observed; HighCPU/5xx alarm context + timeout logs reviewed. Escalated to L2 on-call. L1 monitoring and will update. — L1

debrief.english: Incident comms: facts + escalate + next update.
